I admit I was exploring new ways to engage with my audience and may have inadvertently sent a higher volume of direct messages than usual. I have thoroughly reviewed Instagram's Community Guidelines and Terms of Use to ensure I fully understand and comply with them going forward. I am committed to being a responsible and positive member of the Instagram community.
